theOneCountyProof.rosterCountingRule: UNION of two independently measured id sets, never one derived from the other: 62,257 baked node-facets:tier1 place_keys and 62,398 parcel-node atoms, 62,256 in both, union 62,399
theOneCountyProof.headline: The card calls situsAddress present for 62,257 of 62,399 parcels (99.77%). A human can read an address on 46,153 (73.96%). The 16,104-parcel gap is the literal string ", ," being served as a present address.

whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.lesson: The address gap is a CONCATENATION SENTINEL that survives every emptiness test, not a null.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.evidence: Bastrop tier-1 baked payloads: 46,153 legible and 16,104 punctuation-only of 62,257. ZERO null and ZERO blank. Filtering on IS NOT NULL and on btrim <> '' returns identical counts statewide (12,999,845 both).
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.consequenceForScaling: Any wave that re-uses a null/blank coverage predicate reproduces the 99.3% error. The predicate is the deliverable as much as the counts are.

whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.lesson: MY OWN corrected predicate was ALSO too weak, and only Travis exposed it.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.evidence: The alphanumeric rule counted the Travis-shaped stub ", TX 78754" as an address. Corrected to a street-segment rule; the statewide legible figure moved from 94.64% to 89.90%.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.consequenceForScaling: This is the serial-blocker shape from the L2 lesson, occurring inside the instrument rather than the pipeline. Do not scope a wave on a predicate validated against ONE county's failure mode.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.disposition: hasStreetSegment() in project-sheet.ts names all three rungs of the ladder in source, and states there is no proof it has only three.

whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.lesson: The two counties fail DIFFERENTLY and neither fix generalises from the other.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.evidence: Bastrop: sentinel ", ," recoverable from the cad-parcel-roll atom (59,374 legible Bastrop situs values sitting unread). Travis: city NULL for 380,918 of 380,918, cad-parcel-roll situsAddress NULL for all 492,848 rows, and the operator's exact parcel (17005 Simsbrook Dr) absent from txgio_parcel entirely while txgio_address carries it with coordinates and the city.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.consequenceForScaling: The per-county source review the operator named as the next step is REQUIRED and cannot be replaced by one statewide backfill.

whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.lesson: The largest single defect was invisible to any coverage metric, because it is a SERVING drop rather than a data gap.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.evidence: 608,414 baked tier-2 FEMA flood determinations exist. On the production read path mergeBakedBaseFacts composes from the atom response and never copies tier2 across, so the live body carries no tier2 key at all and every flood-reading surface renders 'flood not verified here'. 62,399 of 62,399 Bastrop parcels.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.consequenceForScaling: A store-side completeness ledger would score this rail 100% complete. Only a served-truth sweep can see it. That is the justification for this instrument existing.

whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.lesson: Two stores hold DIFFERENT FEMA answers for the same parcel.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.evidence: 48021:36521 — place_layer_snapshots tier2 says zone AO (adapter fema:nfhl-flood-zone, vintage 2026-07-21); the flood-hazard-fact atom says AE (adapter fema-nfhl-bulk-v1, vintage NFHL_48_20260101). They disagree on 5,424 of 62,399 Bastrop parcels (8.69%), compared only where both name a zone.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.consequenceForScaling: Fixing the merge without reconciling the stores ships a number that contradicts the other surface 8.69% of the time. Sequence the reconciliation BEFORE the merge fix.

whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.lesson: Runtime is not the constraint; predicate correctness is.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.evidence: Bastrop 62,399 parcels in 107 seconds on 500-parcel index-only probes (EXPLAIN ANALYZE: Index Only Scan, 15.6 ms for 500 parcels x 5 entity types, Heap Fetches 0). Travis 804,458 parcels is running at roughly 580 parcels/sec.
whatTheONECOUNTYTaught.consequenceForScaling: A 254-county wave is hours, not days. The scoping risk is a wrong counting rule scaled 254 times, not compute.

adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.challenge: Does the sweep actually measure what the product serves, or a plausible reconstruction of it?
adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.answer: It measures the served body, proven. The live-wire parity control compares the offline composition against the DEPLOYED endpoint on 10 parcels across 3 counties and all 3 read paths; it passes 12 of 12 and was proven able to fail by mutating a fixture. Production mode was verified by reading X-PE-Read-Path off the deployed surface, not assumed from an env file.

adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.challenge: Two zeros were reported. Are they real, or dead gates?
adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.answer: Real. All five contradiction detectors are shown tripping on constructed payloads in detectors-fire.test.ts. envelope-not-derived-but-area-shown and setbacks-present-card-absent-brief are now structurally impossible WITHIN a single served payload, which relocates the X-ray PDF defect to the surfaces that RE-DERIVE rather than render — brief-view-model.ts:365 reads env.setbacks with no coverage check while compare-facts.ts:269 reads the coverage-gated card facet. Reported as a relocation, never as a clean bill of health.

adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.challenge: Is field-unavailable-but-present-upstream at 100% an artifact of double counting?
adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.answer: No. Contradictions are deduped per parcel before tallying — a fix made after the first smoke run, when a parcel raising the kind by two mechanisms counted twice. 62,257 parcels raise it via the dropped tier2 overlay and 142 via an unnamed county on a parcel with no baked snapshot; the union is 62,399.

adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.challenge: The absence-cluster output for flood and frontage looks like a finding and is not.
adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.answer: Correct, and the report says so. When a field is absent for 100% of parcels the cluster map is parcel density wearing a finding's clothes. Only situsAddress, zoning, setbacks and envelope clusters carry information in Bastrop.

adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.challenge: Is classifying 52,700 no-zoning-stamp parcels as absent-uncovered an inflation of the backlog?
adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.answer: It is the weakest classification in the sweep and the report flags it. The served reason is a statement about our stamp coverage, not about the world, and most unincorporated Texas is genuinely unzoned. The per-parcel reason token is preserved so the irreducible share can be separated later without re-running the sweep.

adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.challenge: Could the sweep's geojson stand-in have changed a served decision?
adversarialReviewOfTHISLANESOWNRESULTS.answer: No, and it is proven rather than asserted. Every read of geojson on the serving path is a null-ness test; geojson-standin tests assert an identical card model and identical field states between a real polygon and the stand-in, and the parity test asserts the feature COUNT matches the live body.
